name: Grafana

database.label: Bundled SQLite by default for dashboards/users; MySQL or PostgreSQL recommended for high-availability or multi-instance setups

resourceFootprint.notes: 512 MB RAM / 0.5 core comfortably renders dozens of dashboards for a homelab. Grafana itself only visualizes data — the real resource cost usually comes from the data sources it queries (Prometheus, Loki, InfluxDB) running alongside it.

screenshots.label: Dashboard
screenshots.altEn: Grafana dashboard showing multiple time-series panels for system metrics
screenshots.altBg: Табло на Grafana с множество панели с времеви редове за системни метрики

screenshots.label: Settings
screenshots.altEn: Grafana data sources settings screen showing configured Prometheus and Loki connections
screenshots.altBg: Екран с настройки на източници на данни в Grafana, показващ конфигурирани връзки към Prometheus и Loki

screenshots.label: Alerting
screenshots.altEn: Grafana alerting rules list showing configured alert conditions and notification channels
screenshots.altBg: Списък с правила за аларми в Grafana, показващ конфигурирани условия и канали за известия

dockerComposeSnippet:
services:
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana-oss:latest
    container_name: grafana
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      - GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD=change-me
    volumes:
      - grafana-data:/var/lib/grafana

volumes:
  grafana-data:
descriptionEn: Grafana is the industry-standard open-source platform for building dashboards and alerts from virtually any data source — Prometheus, Loki, InfluxDB, PostgreSQL and 100+ more via plugins. Paired with Prometheus and Loki it forms the classic self-hosted observability stack for monitoring homelab infrastructure and applications.
descriptionBg: Grafana е индустриалният стандарт за open-source платформа за изграждане на табла и аларми от практически всеки източник на данни — Prometheus, Loki, InfluxDB, PostgreSQL и над 100 други чрез плъгини. В комбинация с Prometheus и Loki образува класическия self-hosted observability stack за мониторинг на homelab инфраструктура и приложения.
taglineEn: Open-source dashboards and alerting for any metrics data source.
taglineBg: Open-source табла и аларми за всеки източник на метрики.
